items.title: Red on Red on Red
items.dek: A vendor market at five and a burlesque show at seven at the Rah Rah Room, shot in the hardest light in the city and printed four ways.

items.title: Bull Madrid, Then Everyone in Black
items.dek: An outdoor lucha ring at El Luchador at 8:48, then MIGX at Mi Vaquita under the biggest LED wall in the city. Three grades for the ring, five for the club.

items.title: Every Room a Different Colour
items.dek: A fundraiser house show in Austin, the first night this desk has shot outside San Antonio, graded twice: once as a party, once off the flyer.

items.title: The Night Before B.I.L.L.Y
items.dek: Mike Dimes threw the B.I.L.L.Y release party in an arcade bar the night before the album dropped. Fifty eight moments, two grades, all free to download.

items.title: The Afterparty Is the San Antonio Date
items.dek: Young Thug plays Austin on September 30 and skips San Antonio, so 3|OAK is throwing the official after party with Thug on the bill.

items.title: San Antonio Goes First
items.dek: J. Cole opens the Texas leg of The Fall-Off World Tour at the Frost Bank Center on September 13. Austin gets him the next night, then Houston twice and Dallas twice.

items.title: Get There Early
items.dek: Ken Carson takes the Xperimenting Tour to Austin and Irving in September, skips San Antonio entirely, and puts xaviersobased on first.

items.title: The Blood Countess Is Playing Austin
items.dek: Fantastic Fest runs September 17 to 24 on South Lamar. Isabelle Huppert plays Elizabeth Bathory, a vampire Santa gets a world premiere, and GWAR closes the whole thing.

items.title: They Will Think You Are A Lunatic
items.dek: Andrew E. put rap on Philippine radio in 1990. He played San Antonio for the first time, then ate lunch on the South Side and told us how it started.

items.title: One Clown Per Five Civilians
items.dek: A Sunday craft market at Rah Rah Room became a comedy stage, then a band, then a wrestling match on the patio.

items.title: Seventeen, A Laptop, Four Hundred Million
items.dek: Kane Parsons made a Backrooms short in Blender at seventeen. A24 put the feature in theatres in May and it has taken close to four hundred million.

items.title: Opium Bought The Whole Convention
items.dek: ComplexCon turns ten and the label built on never being looked at is headlining it. Ken Carson is playing Austin on September 15.

items.title: Nobody Says A Word
items.dek: VOLUME is three minutes of silent comedy in a library. The desk wrote it, shot it, cut it, and is in it.

items.title: The Rage Kid Got Sober
items.dek: Nettspend shaved his head, put his mom on camera, and killed the character that made him famous.

items.title: Goth With a Beauty Budget
items.dek: Pinterest put a name on the look and a number on the name. Here is what happens to a subculture when the forecast finds it.

items.title: The Fall Run
items.dek: Every Texas date that matters between now and Halloween, in one place.
